v_intro_2.text: [whispering] You're awake. Don't make a sound.

v_lock.text: [whispering] It's locked. I need light. Here.

v_guns.text: [whispering] Take one. I'll take the other.

v_guns2.text: [whispering] Point and pull. Don't waste it.

v_cover.text: [urgent] Cover me! I need ten seconds!

a2_fornow.text: [softly] For now. Come here a moment.

s2_madeit.text: [breathless, relieved] We made it... We actually made it out.

s2_nomemory.text: [quiet, stunned] Three days... I don't remember any of it.

s2_what.text: [shaky] Akane... what happened out there? Those... people...

a2_started.text: [sad] It started three days ago. People got sick... and then they got back up. The whole city is under attack. The army pulled out last night.

a2_head.text: [gently] You hit your head when the building shook. I found you in that room. I didn't know if you'd ever wake up.

a2_couldnt.text: [emotional] Everyone else ran. I couldn't leave you.

s2_garden.text: [wondering] Then why is it so peaceful here? Why is there such a beautiful garden?

a2_nogarden.text: [sad, gently] Sara... there is no beautiful garden. You need to face reality.

a2_church.text: [urgent] They found us! The church, across the square. It's the only safe place left. Follow me!

s2_end.text: [breathless] We made it... Thank you, Akane.

a2_blocked.text: [urgent] They walled off the square! Round the side, this way!

a2_stuck.text: [straining, panicked] It won't open! Cover me, I have to force it!

s2_cover.text: [determined, breathless] Go! I've got your back!

a2_bus.text: [urgent] The road's blocked! In here, through the restaurant!

v_akane_dead.text: [screaming, devastated] Akane! No... no, no, no!

a3_go.text: [straining] Sara, go! See if he's alright!

p_easy.text: [startled, then gently] Easy, child... easy. I'm not one of them.

a3_hold.text: [straining, breathless] Don't thank me yet! There's someone up by the altar... the priest? Go, check on him! I'll hold the door!

s3_alone.text: [shaky, relieved] Father... are you alone here?

p_others.text: [tired, sad] The others left with the army. Someone had to stay... and keep the candles lit.

a3_in.text: [screaming] They're in! Sara, run! The back door, go!

s3_come.text: [urgent, pleading] Father, come with us! Please!

p_go.text: [urgent] Go! Out the back... and follow the lights.

p_home.text: [calm, firm] No. This is my home. I will not leave it.

p_bless.text: [softly, at peace] God keep you, child.

a3_come.text: [breathless, shaken] Come on... we can't stay here.

a3_lights.text: [breathless] He said follow the lights... Stay with me.

a3_further.text: [worried] Hold on, Sara. Just a little further.

a3_sleep.text: [worried, gently] Sara... you don't look well. You're burning up. Lie down. Sleep. I'll keep watch.

s3_out.text: [urgent, hushed] They're breaking in. Is there another way out?

a3_go2.text: [straining] Sara, go! Find us a way out!

a3_hold2.text: [straining, breathless] Sara, I'll hold the door! Go check if there's an exit!

p_back.text: [tired, sad] The door behind the altar. We barred it, the first night... It won't move for an old man.

p_save.text: [softly, sadly] You can't save everyone, Sara.

s3_fine0.text: [shaky] I'm fine. Please... come with us. Akane can open it.

s3_name.text: [uneasy, quiet] ...How do you know my name?

p_told.text: [softly, with a sad smile] You told me. Don't you remember?

a3_blocked.text: [panicked, straining] It's barricaded! Sara, keep them back! Keep them off me!

p_pray1.text: [praying aloud, voice shaking] Our Father, who art in heaven... hallowed be thy name...

p_pray3.text: [praying, trembling] Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy.

p_pray2.text: [praying aloud, louder, desperate] Deliver us from evil... Deliver us from evil!

p_getback.text: [shouting, frightened] Get back! Get back from me!

a3_one.text: [straining, breathless] One more... come on, come on!

a3_open2.text: [screaming] It's open! Sara, now! Come on!

a3_what.text: [screaming] Sara! What are you doing?! Come on!

s3_blame2.text: [crying] It's my fault. I should have made him come...

s3_blame1.text: [sobbing, breathless] I had him... He was right there, Akane... I should have...

a3_who.text: [breathless, confused] Sara... who? Who are you talking about?

s3_priest.text: [upset] The priest! The old man at the altar! You saw him!

a3_nopriest.text: [quiet, scared] Sara... there was no one at the altar. There was no priest. I never saw anyone.

s3_knew.text: [whispering, shaken] No... He talked to me. He knew my name...

a3_unwell.text: [gently, worried] You were shouting at an empty church. You're not well, Sara.

s3_follow.text: [whispering, to herself] Follow the lights... he said.

a3_lights2.text: [whispering] Lanterns... Someone's been keeping these lit. Stay close to me.

a3_light.text: [urgent] Sara, your light! Use your light!

s3_see.text: [whispering, shaken] Akane... did you see that?

s3_cant.text: [gasping, weak] Akane... I can't... I can't see...

a3_seewhat.text: [whispering, worried] See what? ... There's nothing there. Keep moving.

a3_house2.text: [screaming, breathless] A house! Run! Go, go, go!

a3_windows.text: [urgent, breathless] The windows! Close the windows!

a3_lampout.text: [whispering, urgent] The lamp. Put it out.

a3_shh.text: [whispering] Shh... Don't move. Don't make a sound.

s3_w_real.text: [whispering, shaky] Akane... he was real. I saw him...

a3_w_sleep.text: [whispering, gently] Not now. You're burning up... Lie down. Sleep. I'll watch the door.

a3_lightoff.text: [whispering, urgent] Your light... Turn it off.

a3_w_lamp.text: [whispering] I'll light the lamp. Just a little.

p_last.text: [weak, gasping, dying] Go... child... follow... the lights...

a3_c_people.text: [whispering, sad] People came this way... Not all of them made it.

s3_move.text: [determined, breathless] It's okay. We will move it.

p_back2.text: [tired, quiet] The door behind the altar. It's barred.

a3_moto.text: [urgent] Wait... there's a motorcycle! Come on, hurry!

s3_failed.text: [crying, raising her voice over the engine] I failed to save him...

s3_priest2.text: [upset, shouting] The priest! You saw him!

a3_who2.text: [shouting over the engine, confused] Sara... who? Who are you talking about?

a3_nopriest2.text: [quiet, scared] Sara... there was no one at the altar. There was no priest.

a3_r_shoot3.text: [urgent, shouting] On the path! Shoot it!

a3_r_off.text: [shouting, breathless] Off! Off! Get inside, go!

a3_window.text: [screaming] Sara, the window! They're coming in!

p3s_wake.text: [groggy, confused] Mm... Akane? What is it...?

p3a_trap.text: [whispering, excited] I found a trapdoor under the rug. There's a ladder. It goes down.

p3a_hurry.text: [shouting, from below] Sara! Hurry! Get down here!

p3a_hurry2.text: [shouting, echoing] Sara, come on! The ladder!

p3a_platform.text: [whispering, tense] There's some of them on the platform. Get ready.

p3a_metro.text: [whispering, amazed] A service shaft... for the metro. This line runs under the whole city.

p3a_hear.text: [uneasy, whispering] Wait. Do you hear that?

p3a_train.text: [shocked] A train? The trains are still running?!

p3a_getin.text: [shouting] Get in! Get in the train!

p3a_stairs.text: [screaming] They're coming down the stairs! Go, go!

p3a_made.text: [breathless, a shaky laugh] We... we actually made it.

p3a_nobody.text: [uneasy, quiet] Nobody. It just keeps running its line... like nothing happened.

p3a_dontlook.text: [scared, firm] Don't look at it. The door's locked. It can't get through.

p3a_park.text: [determined] Parkgate comes up right under the park. We go up, and we find a way out of this city.

p3a_stairs2.text: [shouting] This way! The stairs! Go up!

p3a_gates.text: [breathless, shouting] Over the gates! Come on!

p3a_heli.text: [breathless, stunned] Sara... look. Over there. Is that... a helicopter?

p3a_almost.text: [shouting, breathless] Almost there! Go, go, go!

p3s_fly.text: [panicked, shouting] Can you even fly this thing?!

p3a_findout.text: [frantic, shouting] We're about to find out!

p3a_start.text: [straining, panicked] Come on, come on... start!

p3a_holdoff.text: [screaming] Hold them off! I need ten seconds!

p3a_f_blind.text: [panicked] I can't see! I can't see anything!

p3a_f_other.text: [shocked, shouting] The other chopper! It's going down!

p3a_f_pullup.text: [screaming] Pull up, pull up, pull up!

p3a_f_comeon.text: [frantic] Come on, come on, come on!

p3a_f_laugh.text: [breathless, a hysterical laugh] We're alive... we're actually alive!

p3a_f_brace.text: [screaming] We're going down! Hold on to me!

p3n_ashwood.text: [calm, formal station announcement] Ashwood. The train now arriving is for Parkgate.

p3n_doors.text: [calm, formal announcement] Please stand clear of the closing doors.

p3n_next.text: [calm, formal announcement] The next station is Parkgate. Parkgate is the last stop.

p3n_last.text: [calm, formal announcement] Parkgate. This is the last stop. This train terminates here. Please make sure you have all your belongings with you. Thank you for travelling with us.

train_horn.text: A metro train's two-tone electric horn blaring in an underground tunnel, echoing

train_door_chime.text: A metro train's door chime: a clear two-tone electronic ding-dong

train_pa_chime.text: A train's public address chime before an announcement: three soft rising electronic tones, slightly distorted through an old speaker

train_brake.text: A metro train braking: brakes squealing, the car rattling, the motors winding down, a final hiss of air

train_door_open.text: Metro train sliding doors opening with a pneumatic hiss and a rumble of rollers

train_door_close.text: Metro train sliding doors closing: a rapid warning beeping, then the doors thud shut with a pneumatic hiss

train_gangway_bang.text: Fists banging hard on the glass window of a train door, the glass rattling in its frame, close, horror

heli_lowrpm_horn.text: A helicopter low rotor RPM warning horn: a loud repeating whooping alarm

heli_wind.text: Strong wind roaring through an open helicopter door at speed

metro_tube_buzz.text: A failing fluorescent tube buzzing and flickering, clicking on and off with an electrical crackle

metro_staff_door_open.text: A heavy steel fire door with a push bar opened, the bar clunks and the door scrapes and booms against the wall, echoing in a concrete corridor

crane_groan.text: A huge steel tower crane groaning and creaking as its jib swings, deep metallic stress sounds

tank_fall.text: A large wooden water tower on a rooftop collapsing, its legs snapping, and crashing down with a huge splash and splintering wood

heli2_explosion.text: A huge explosion as a helicopter slams into a building, a deep booming fireball and debris and glass raining down, distant echo

wires_snap.text: High voltage power lines snapping, loud electric arcs crackling and buzzing, sparks

p3a_t_back.text: [shouting] Sara, behind you! The other end!

p3a_t_cars.text: [panicked, shouting] They got on the train! They're in the other cars!

p3a_ammo2.text: [urgent] Here, take these! Make them count!

p3a_ammo.text: [urgent, shouting] Sara! Catch! My spare mags!

p3a_t_clear.text: [breathless, shaky] Is that... all of them?

p3a_a_wall.text: [whispering, tense] Stay behind me. Along the wall.

p3a_p_this.text: [shouting, breathless] This way! Stay with me!

p3a_t_inside.text: [screaming] They're in the train! Shoot them!
